text: Hello, children! I'm Kokeb, the star, and these are my friends Saba and Dawit.
Look! Our animal friends have come to school too: the lion, the gelada, the walia ibex, the cow and the chicken!
Today in Grade 3 English we learn two units. Unit 1 is My School, and Unit 2 is Months of the Year.
We will sing, dance eskista and learn lots of new words. Let's go!
